description: This file provides compatibility wrappers for the /sbin/uci command in OpenWrt, including functions for loading configuration, setting defaults, reverting and setting states, toggling states, adding/removing list items, getting/setting configuration options, and committing changes.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data for a specified package, exporting environment variables.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default UCI configuration for a package if not already set.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration to the state stored in /var/state.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific UCI configuration option in the stored state.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI configuration state, effectively toggling it.

methods.name: uci_set
methods.description: Sets a UCI configuration option directly.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a list option in UCI.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI config option from the stored state.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current UCI configuration option, with an optional default value.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI config section or set sub-section.

methods.name: uci_rename
methods.description: Renames a UCI configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a UCI configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a value from a list option in UCI.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts a UCI configuration option to a previous state.
